chapters.reason: The paper introduces MoBA, a Mixture of Experts approach to attention, specifically designed to reduce the quadratic complexity of standard attention mechanisms for long-context LLMs.
The paper highlights the deployment of MoBA in Kimi to support long-context requests, demonstrating its practical application in real-world production systems.
The paper evaluates the performance of MoBA on long-context tasks, focusing on the trade-off between computational efficiency and model performance.
